questions.q: What question does this course say best distinguishes a technical architect's thinking from an admin's?
options: Does this satisfy today's ticket?
Will this hold up under requirements nobody has written down yet, years from now?
Can this be built without writing any Apex?
Will this pass the next Salesforce release's regression tests automatically?
questions.explain: An admin or developer typically solves the requirement in front of them; the architect is accountable for whether the design still holds up over the solution's full lifecycle, under future requirements nobody has specified yet.

questions.q: Which Salesforce architect domain credential focuses on off-platform systems, integration, and identity/access between systems?
options: Application Architect
Platform Developer II
System Architect
Admin
questions.explain: The System Architect credential is focused specifically on what happens outside the core platform: integration, identity and access between systems, and deployment governance.

questions.q: Which Salesforce architect domain credential focuses on native platform depth, including data modeling and sharing?
options: Application Architect
System Architect
Development Lifecycle and Deployment Architect only
There is no such domain credential
questions.explain: The Application Architect credential covers deep knowledge of native Salesforce functionality, including data modeling, application design, and sharing and visibility.

questions.q: How does a candidate earn the Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) credential?
options: A single 60-question multiple-choice exam
By completing every Trailhead badge in the Architect trail
An Architect Review Board: a prerequisites/experience evaluation, then a scenario-based exam presented and defended before a panel of CTAs
Automatic promotion after five years holding the System Architect credential
questions.explain: The CTA credential is earned through a two-step Architect Review Board — an evaluation step, then a review board exam where the candidate designs a solution to a scenario and defends it live before a panel of existing CTAs.

questions.q: Which statement best describes what a technical architect's day-to-day output typically looks like?
options: Mostly hands-on Apex and Lightning Web Component code, written personally
Decisions, diagrams, and documented trade-offs that keep a solution's domains coherent together
Exclusively user and permission-set administration
Writing the company's marketing copy for new Salesforce features
questions.explain: A technical architect often writes little or no code personally — the role's real output is making decisions and documenting trade-offs so that separately-good decisions across domains don't quietly conflict with each other.
